title: The boundary is the concept
alt_text: OBLIGRA VERIFY RESOURCE HUB  /  08 ARCHITECTURE DEFINITIONS The boundary is the concept The customer-owned proxy is an implementation of that boundary. ARCHITECTURAL CONCEPT Customer-owned capture boundary Where the customer decides what becomes a record and which fields may leave their environment. Commonly implemented by CUSTOMER-DEPLOYED SERVICE Customer-owned proxy 1 Capture policy Capture or skip 2 Field policy Choose allowed fields 3 Forwarder Send approved payload The customer runs the proxy. The boundary describes the responsibility, not a separate product. obligra.ai  /  Resource Hub Concept explainer · Read the linked source
editorial_note: Concept versus implementation and three proxy responsibilities preserved. Deployment tooling details omitted.
